# Ridgeline

> Ridgeline is a live observatory for the MeshCore LoRa mesh network across Vancouver Island and the Lower Mainland of British Columbia, Canada. Receive-only observer stations report every packet they hear; Ridgeline turns that into a node and repeater directory, a live packet feed, coverage maps and link-health analytics for the mesh on 909.000 MHz.

MeshCore is an off-grid, long-range text-messaging mesh built on low-cost LoRa radios: repeaters on hilltops and rooftops relay messages between companion radios with no internet or cell service. Every node page is listed in the sitemap.

## Pages

- [About Ridgeline and the MeshCore mesh](https://ridgeline.ve7kod.ca/about): what the mesh is, how to join, radio settings
- [Multi-byte hash IDs](https://ridgeline.ve7kod.ca/hash-ids): why meshes outgrow 1-byte path IDs and how to move a node to 2- or 3-byte IDs
- [Node and repeater directory](https://ridgeline.ve7kod.ca/nodes): every node heard, with a page per node
- [Coverage map](https://ridgeline.ve7kod.ca/map)
- [Live signal map](https://ridgeline.ve7kod.ca/live-map)
- [Live packet feed](https://ridgeline.ve7kod.ca/live)
- [Network analytics](https://ridgeline.ve7kod.ca/analytics)
- [Channels](https://ridgeline.ve7kod.ca/channels), including #sos, the mesh's permanent emergency channel
- [Observers](https://ridgeline.ve7kod.ca/observers): the receive-only stations feeding Ridgeline
